newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka awards June 21-22 diesel, jet to Total.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka awards June 21-22 diesel, jet to Total.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded its tender to buy diesel and jet for June 21-22 delivery to French major Total, a company official said on Wednesday.
CPC sold the 220,000 barrels of gas oil and 80,000 barrels of jet at a 10-cent discount to Singapore spot published quotes on a cost and freight Colombo basis, the official said.
The tender closed June 4 and was valid until June 6.
In its last tender for June 10-11 delivery cargoes, CPC sold a similar size diesel cargo at a five-cent premium and a jet cargo at a 10-cent premium to Singapore quotes.
CPC is expected to award its tender to buy its fourth diesel cargo for June delivery on Thursday.
CPC has raised middle distillates imports for June due to the unexpected shutdown of its 55,000 barrels-per-day Sapugaskandan refinery, after its single point mooring buoy was damaged in an accident.
Sri Lanka normally imports two or three cargoes of middle distillates each month.
The refinery resumed operations on Tuesday, officials said on Wednesday.
